proposalRequirements: Proposals start as ELIPs. Anyone can raise an idea on forum.eigenlayer.xyz, and Eigen Labs currently writes and submits the formal ELIPs. The Protocol Council reviews each final proposal and approves or rejects it. On-chain, only the Operations Multisig (3-of-6 Safe) and the Protocol Council (3-of-5 Safe) hold PROPOSER_ROLE on the core timelock. The Protocol Council is the only EXECUTOR_ROLE holder and the Operations Multisig holds CANCELLER_ROLE. The Community Multisig (9-of-13) holds TIMELOCK_ADMIN_ROLE and signs for the 1-of-2 Executor Multisig that owns the ProxyAdmin, so it can skip the timelock in an emergency.
votingProcess: An ELIP is discussed on the forum and reviewed by the Protocol Council. Once approved, the proposer (usually the Operations Multisig) queues it in the core timelock and publishes a transparency report. After the 10-day delay the Protocol Council (3-of-5) executes it. The Operations Multisig can cancel a queued action, and the Community Multisig (9-of-13) can act without delay in an emergency.
